title: Test in the formats taught
statement: A mastery test should use the formats students met during instruction.
detail: The Direct Instruction BrainLift attached to a July 2026 feedback round on the reading course says mastery tests should match formats experienced during instruction. It is an adopted rule here; nothing in these sources measured it.

evidence.quote: - Mastery tests should match formats experienced during instruction.
Students encounter secondary-source claims, primary text, and non-text sources during instruction. Unit 1's checkpoint includes one SAQ for each modality.
